question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 to $108.0B ±2% (ex-China DC compute). Over the last six quarters actuals beat the guide midpoint by 2.5-5.7% (Q2 FY27 96.2 vs 91; Q3 FY26 57.0 vs 54; Q4 FY26 68.1 vs 65), mean ~4.5%. Applying that gives a median of ~$113B. Sell-side consensus is ~$111.3B. Upside: China orders and the Rubin ramp; downside: supply constraints and sequential growth slowing to ~12%. A beat above 7% (>$116B) gets ~7%; below $105B is negligible. No human market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Nvidia Q2 FY27 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026): revenue $96.221B, up 18% QoQ and 106% YoY; Data Center $89.0B (Nvidia press release, Aug 26, 2026).
- Q2 FY27 prior guide midpoint was $91.0B, so the actual came in +5.7% (stocktitan/dataporium, Aug 2026).
- Q3 FY27 guide: $108.0B ±2% (range $105.8-110.2B), gross margin 74.0%; assumes no China Data Center compute revenue (Nvidia release / dataporium, Aug 2026). Pre-guide street expectation was ~$104.2B.
- Implied sequential growth at the guide midpoint is ~12%, versus 18% in Q2 (dataporium).
- Past actual vs guide midpoint: Q1 FY26 44.06 vs 43 (+2.5%, H20 China hit); Q2 FY26 46.74 vs 45 (+3.9%); Q3 FY26 57.0 vs 54 (+5.6%); Q4 FY26 68.1 vs 65 (+4.8%); Q1 FY27 81.6 vs ~78 (~+4.6%); Q2 FY27 96.2 vs 91 (+5.7%). FY25 quarters were beats of roughly +4-8%. No miss below the guide midpoint in this span.
- Chartmill consensus for Q3 FY27 revenue is ~$111.3B (accessed Oct 2026).
- Oct 21, 2026 (24/7 Wall St): ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered ~$35B of Nvidia chips, but production caps may allow only 5-10% to be filled. In March 2026 Nvidia halted China H200 production and shifted capacity to Vera Rubin (Digitimes).
- Nvidia calls its outlook supply-constrained; it gave FY28 growth guidance of ~70%; Rubin starts shipping in H2 FY27 (tokenpost/various).
- Motley Fool (Sep 15, 2026) argues the $108B guide is conservative.
- Status quo: Nvidia prints above the guide midpoint.
- Resolves off the revenue in Nvidia's Q3 FY27 8-K/press release (expected ~Nov 25, 2026), not later revisions. Event window: first release after Sep 30, 2026 -> before Jan 1, 2027; as of Oct 24, 2026 the report has not been released.
- Searched for Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold markets on Nvidia Q3 revenue: none found. Searched for October 2026 pre-announcements or guidance changes: none found.

calls.reasoning: Guide is $108.0B ±2%, excluding China data-center sales. In the last 8 quarters Nvidia beat the guidance midpoint by 2.5-7.9%, and by 4.6-5.7% in the last 4. A ~4.6% beat gives a median of about $113B. Upside: the Rubin ramp and China. Downside: the switch to Rubin and supply limits. Above $116B needs a beat over 7.4% (seen once in 8 quarters), so ~8%. Below $105B needs a miss of the guide floor, so ~1%. No human prediction market found (all three runs checked Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold and bookmakers). Percentiles are conditional on landing inside the range.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the guide ($108B ±2%, ex-China) and the beat history (no miss of guidance; 2.5-7.9% beats, recent ~5%). Their consensus figures differ ($108.8-109B vs $111.3B). That is likely different aggregators and dates and can't be settled without web access; it matters little because consensus has sat below actuals in every recent quarter. The report date differs (MarketBeat Nov 18 vs Nov 25); this doesn't affect resolution. The judgment calls were the upper-tail mass (7-11%) and the median ($112.4-113.0B). With 1 of 8 quarters beating by more than 7.4%, but recent beats tightly clustered and some Rubin-transition risk, I took ~8% above the range and a median near $112.9B. I kept a dispersion close to Runs 1/3 (~$4.3B) and added 1% below the range for the tail risk of missing guidance.
